author: Epic Games
description:
Blades of Fire Version 2.0 is available now on Epic Games Store!  https://epic.gm/blades-of-fire

Version 2.0 brings brand-new content, improvements, and features to MercurySteam's dark fantasy adventure, including Photo Mode, New Game+, Titanium Difficulty, all-new weapon parts and skins (available in New Game+), Boss Revival Mode, element transmutation, and more!  

Oh… and you can now pet the ox!  

Are you ready to Forge Your Legend?
title: Blades of Fire | Version 2.0 Launch Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
Season 8: Sins of Alchemax is imminent! The Gilded Saint may have purged the Time Plague from Lower Manhattan, but the root of the rot remains. Alchemax Headquarters stands defiant, shielded by a mysterious crimson Chronovium — fueled by a dimension of pure, kinetic force.

Play now on the Epic Games Store! https://epic.gm/marvel-rivals
